issues.title: Validate tenant lease end date before saving
body: The Add Tenant form should show a clear validation message when Lease End is earlier than Lease Start instead of submitting to Supabase and showing a generic save error.
1. Go to the Add Tenant page.
3. Enter a Lease End date earlier than the start date.
- A clear validation message is shown.
- The database constraint remains as a backup.
The form submits to Supabase and shows a generic save error.
